decisions.statement: The kind of page is read from the path rather than from the index.
A path the naming grammar reads as no page file is refused.
A page type is refused here.
The refusal for a page type names the change that takes a page type away.
A page that is no page type is handed to the partial change taking that kind of page away.
Nothing here works out a body of its own.
A page property is handed to the partial change taking a page property away.

definition: one page taken away, by the partial change fitting the kind of page named
